name: Helen
source:
Alexandria's sister and friend. She is diplomatic, kind, and wise beyond her years. She has taken the role of diplomat once held by her mother and spends the majority of her time aiding the other Demon cities and gathering support for the war effort.

[From [url=https://yoshibb.itch.io/divide]itch.io[/url]]
